jsonld_raw.name: ZARAILLUSION EDP 80ML (2.71 FL. OZ)
jsonld_raw.description:
ZARAILLUSION EDP 80ML (2.71 FL. OZ). Accompanies you through every moment of the day with naturalness and sophistication. A versatile perfume that melts into the skin like a second skin: intimate, elegant, and personal.

Orange blossom provides a delicate floral luminosity, while jasmine introduces a soft and enveloping femininity. Vanilla creates a warm and addictive base that adds depth and a comforting sensation that subtly lingers on the skin.

An intimate and modern fragrance that doesn't overwhelm, but rather accompanies, leaving an elegant trail that invites closeness.

Floral amber | Natural, elegant, and enveloping.
